# platform-orchestrator_module_version_pin (Resource)

Manages one exact Core Environment Module Version Pin. Pin authority is Environment scoped and independent from add-on control. Destroy performs an explicit audited Unpin or permanent discard; override-pending Pins remain operation locked.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_uuid` (String)
- `module_uuid` (String)
- `project_uuid` (String)
- `version_uuid` (String)

### Optional

- `confirm_defective_version` (Boolean) Exact acknowledgement required with the dedicated capability when pinning an active Defective Version.
- `reason` (String) Immutable human-readable creation reason. Required when creating a Pin and recovered from its append-only history during import.
- `removal_reason` (String) Human-readable reason used if Terraform destroys this Pin. Required at destroy time.

### Read-Only

- `activation_event_id` (String) Immutable approval boundary of the current protection.
- `created_by` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `override_deployment_id` (String)
- `override_operation_id` (String)
- `resource_version` (Number)
- `status` (String)
